strings.name: Tony Elumelu
strings.summary: Elumelu moved from sales and banking to a 1997 bank turnaround and the 2005 UBA merger. He founded Heirs Holdings and his foundation in 2010, investing in energy, power and hospitality while supporting entrepreneurs. He left UBA’s chairmanship in 2026 and joined Seplat’s board; its chairmanship is scheduled for January 2027.
